reason: A DSH plugin manager that detects package changes and hot-loads, unloads, enables, disables, or updates plugins through Cordis without routine application restarts.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 提供插件热插拔管理，在运行时检测并加载、卸载、启用或禁用插件。
summaries.en: A DSH plugin manager that detects package changes and loads, unloads, enables, or disables plugins at runtime.

capabilities: Watches package metadata for plugin changes
Loads and unloads plugins at runtime
Enables and disables plugins without restarting DSH
Performs plugin cleanup and rollback during lifecycle changes
